topic: Fees and costs not counted in the selling price
problem: Orders keep coming, but after marketplace fees, shipping, returns and ad spend there is little or no profit left, because the selling price was set without counting every cost.
solution: Write down every cost for each product, include fees, shipping and returns, count ad spend per order, and change or stop prices that lose money.
title: I sell a lot but make no profit
items: Count ad spend per order too

topic: Own website does not build trust
problem: People land on the website but leave without buying, because the site does not give them enough reasons to trust a brand they do not know yet.
solution: Make contact details easy to find, explain shipping and returns in plain words, use real photos of the actual product, and show reviews from real buyers.
title: My website doesn't build trust

topic: Reports with numbers but no next step
problem: Every week the report is full of numbers, but nobody knows what to do differently, so the same problems repeat.
solution: Open each report with what changed, explain why it changed, agree on one or two actions, name who owns each one, and check them in the next report.
title: Reports full of numbers, no next step
items: Agree on one or two actions
line: A good report tells you what to do next.
